segments.name: Aerospace and Defense Electronics
segments.description: Supplies aerospace and defense electronics, from components and modules to integrated solutions, to U.S. and European defense prime contractors, governments and commercial aerospace OEMs.
segments.evidence: There has been no change to the Company's conclusion of one operating and reportable segment in fiscal 2026.

revenueModel.text: Defense prime contractors, the U.S. government, foreign governments and commercial aerospace OEMs pay for processing components, modules and integrated solutions, largely under defense program subcontracts.
revenueModel.evidence: we sell to the top U.S. and European defense prime contractors, the U.S. government and original equipment manufacturers

changes.text: In fiscal 2026 the company consolidated two divisions into a single integrated structure, but kept one operating and reportable segment.
changes.evidence: During the second quarter of fiscal 2026, the Company completed its internal reorganization, which changed how segment management reviewed discrete financial information, by consolidating two divisions into a single integrated structure that unified all lines of business and matrixed business functions.
